conclusion: NULL / UNINFORMATIVE RESULT: TF-IDF gives zero lexical similarity between natural-language questions and short technical target names for the large majority of targets, so neither system can retrieve them regardless of cost. This is a scorer limitation, not a finding about the hierarchy's usefulness. A denser embedding scorer is needed before this comparison is informative.
caveat: An earlier version of this script reported a positive-looking result (hierarchical beating flat at low cost) that was an artifact of non-deterministic Python set iteration order breaking ties among zero-similarity candidates — corrected here.
